sub_fields.label: Show
sub_fields.name: archive_mode
sub_fields.instructions: Posts displays post cards. Terms lists taxonomy terms with links to their archives.

sub_fields.label: Post type
sub_fields.name: post_type
sub_fields.instructions: Select the public post type for this independent query.

sub_fields.label: Number of items
sub_fields.name: posts_per_page
sub_fields.instructions: Maximum 100 items. Leave empty to use the WordPress Reading setting. Results have no numbered pagination.

sub_fields.label: Exclude current content
sub_fields.name: exclude_current
sub_fields.message: Exclude the page or single post currently displayed.

sub_fields.label: Taxonomy
sub_fields.name: taxonomy
sub_fields.instructions: For posts, select the taxonomy to filter by slug. For terms, select the taxonomy to list.

sub_fields.label: Term slugs
sub_fields.name: term_slugs
sub_fields.instructions: Enter comma-separated term slugs to match any listed term, or leave empty for all. Find slugs in the term editor.

sub_fields.label: Hide empty terms
sub_fields.name: terms_hide_empty
sub_fields.instructions: Use the standard WordPress term count across associated post types.

sub_fields.label: Parent term slug
sub_fields.name: terms_parent
sub_fields.instructions: For hierarchical taxonomies, enter the parent slug to list its direct children. This overrides the top-level setting. Unknown slugs return no results.

sub_fields.label: Top level only
sub_fields.name: terms_top_level
sub_fields.instructions: List parentless terms. Applies to hierarchical taxonomies when the parent field is empty.

sub_fields.label: Card template
sub_fields.name: tease
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the template name without tease- or .twig, e.g. card, compact, editorial, horizontal, overlay, post, section, text, title or vertical. Leave empty for the post type template or default card.

sub_fields.label: Card classes
sub_fields.name: inner_class
sub_fields.instructions: Use col-12 col-md-6 for item widths or mb-4 for spacing.

sub_fields.label: Show description
sub_fields.name: terms_show_description
sub_fields.instructions: Show up to 35 words from the term description.

sub_fields.label: Show WordPress count
sub_fields.name: terms_show_count
sub_fields.instructions: Show the WordPress term count across associated post types.

sub_fields.label: How to use this layout
sub_fields.message: In Block classes, choose archive-masonry for staggered cards or archive-carousel carousel-items-2 for a two-card carousel. Use Card classes for card widths in a grid. Set the outer width on the column.

sub_fields.label: Map locations
sub_fields.name: section_maps
sub_fields.instructions: Add one row per location. Rows require valid coordinates. Multiple locations fit automatically unless a centre is set.

sub_fields.label: Location title
sub_fields.name: section_maps_title
sub_fields.instructions: Location name for the list and marker. Leave empty to use a numbered title.

sub_fields.label: Address or description
sub_fields.name: section_maps_description
sub_fields.instructions: Shown in the list and marker. Directions use the pin coordinates.

sub_fields.label: Location pin
sub_fields.name: section_maps_pin
sub_fields.instructions: Search for an address and check the pin. Zero is a valid coordinate.

sub_fields.label: How to use this layout
sub_fields.message: Add a pin for each location. Set the map width on the column, e.g. col-12 col-md-8. For an introduction, add a Text block before Maps.

sub_fields.instructions: For a spacer, leave Columns empty and enter py-5 in Section classes.

sub_fields.label: Contained
sub_fields.name: contained
sub_fields.instructions: Limit the inner container width. Disable for a full-width section.

sub_fields.label: Before page content
sub_fields.name: pre_content
sub_fields.instructions: Show the section before the WordPress content. Disable to show it afterwards.

sub_fields.label: Section classes
sub_fields.name: class
sub_fields.instructions: Enter section classes separated by spaces, without dots. See Guide for column and block examples.

sub_fields.label: Row classes
sub_fields.name: row_class
sub_fields.instructions: Classes on the main row, e.g. bg-primary mb-4. Separate classes with spaces and omit the dots.

sub_fields.label: How to use this layout
sub_fields.message: Use Section classes for spacing (py-5) or a background image effect (parallax). In Column → Column classes, col-12 col-md-6 sets the width. With at least two Text blocks and no other block types, text-carousel scrolls them and text-masonry arranges them in a grid. Use Row classes for a row background or margin, e.g. bg-primary mb-4. For a spacer, leave Columns empty and enter py-5 in Section classes.

sub_fields.label: Page
sub_fields.name: page
sub_fields.instructions: Select a source page. Drafts are supported. Read Guide before publishing.

sub_fields.label: How to use this layout
sub_fields.message: Reuse the source sections one level deep. Draft content can appear on a published destination. Password protection and each source section’s position before or after WordPress content still apply. Nested page references are skipped.
